levitatorSystems.name: Commercial Continuous Multi-Transducer Phased Array Ultrasonic Levitation Dehydration Tunnel (40 kHz, 16-Node Trap Corridor)
levitatorSystems.classification: Continuous Industrial Acoustic Levitation Evaporator (FDA 21 CFR § 117 / 3-A Sanitary / ASME BPE-2024)
levitatorSystems.transducerType: Dual-Opposed Piezoelectric Langevin Bolted Horns (Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 Titanium Alloy)
levitatorSystems.description: Continuous conveyor-style non-contact drying corridor utilizing 16 pairs of precision-opposed 40 kHz Langevin ultrasonic horns. Droplets introduced via piezoceramic micro-dispensers are stably trapped at acoustic pressure nodes and advanced along the corridor via subtle transducer phase modulation (Δϕ = 15°/step), providing containerless drying with zero wall contact.

levitatorSystems.name: High-Throughput Single-Horn Curved Parabolic Reflector Resonant Skid (22 kHz, High-Volume 8-Stage Levitator)
levitatorSystems.classification: Industrial Acoustic Levitation Skid (EHEDG Doc 8 / CE Machinery Directive)
levitatorSystems.transducerType: High-Power 1200W Langevin Ultrasonic Horn with Opposed Concave Parabolic AISI 316L Reflector
levitatorSystems.description: High-capacity commercial acoustic levitator utilizing a lower 22 kHz operating frequency to establish large standing-wave nodes capable of levitating heavy droplets up to 3.2 mm in diameter. Concave acoustic reflection focuses acoustic radiation pressure into deep potential wells for high-throughput continuous food processing.

levitatorSystems.name: Aseptic Biopharmaceutical Droplet-on-Demand (DoD) Acoustic Drying Column (40 kHz, Micro-Dispenser Feed)
levitatorSystems.classification: Aseptic Bioprocess Evaporator (ASME BPE / FDA cGMP / ISO 5 Cleanroom)
levitatorSystems.transducerType: Hermetically Sealed Cleanroom Langevin Array with Stepped Steatite Horns
levitatorSystems.description: Ultra-clean containerless drying column designed for high-potency biologics, pure enzymes, and sensitive monoclonal antibody concentrates. Operates inside a class 100 laminar cleanroom envelope with automated optical droplet tracking and micro-dispenser dosing.

levitatorSystems.name: Pilot Continuous Variable-Frequency Dual-Axis Resonant Levitator (20–40 kHz Swept-Wave)
levitatorSystems.classification: R&D Food Engineering Pilot Rig (ASTM E1002 / IEEE 145)
levitatorSystems.transducerType: Broadband Piezoelectric Ceramic Stack with Variable Node Pitch Horn
levitatorSystems.description: Versatile pilot testing unit featuring swept-frequency resonance tracking to match variable chamber ambient temperatures and evolving droplet acoustic impedance as moisture evaporates.

thermolabileSubstrates.name: Pure Fresh Royal Jelly Secretion (Major Royal Jelly Proteins MRJPs / 10-HDA)
thermolabileSubstrates.description: High-value apicultural secretion containing delicate bioactive royalactin and fatty acids. Extremely prone to thermal denaturing and sticky chamber wall adhesion in conventional dryers.

thermolabileSubstrates.name: Purified β-Galactosidase (Lactase) Microbial Broth (Kluyveromyces lactis)
thermolabileSubstrates.description: Thermally sensitive digestive enzyme essential for lactose-free dairy processing. Suffers irreversible tertiary structure unfolding when exposed to droplet spray drying temperatures above 42°C.

thermolabileSubstrates.name: Bovine Hyperimmune Colostrum IgG Immunoglobulins & Lactoferrin
thermolabileSubstrates.description: Immunologically active colostrum proteins. Contactless acoustic levitation avoids shear stress from atomizing nozzles and eliminates wall scorching entirely.

thermolabileSubstrates.name: Wild Bilberry Cold-Pressed Anthocyanin & Volatile Ester Essence
thermolabileSubstrates.description: Polyphenolic botanical extract containing fragile anthocyanin colorants and volatile top-note fruit esters that flash-boil off during vacuum evaporation.

carrierGases.name: High-Purity Dry Nitrogen Carrier (N2, 99.999%, Dewpoint -70°C)
carrierGases.description: Continuous laminar blanket of high-purity nitrogen gas preventing any aerobic auto-oxidation of polyphenols, vitamins, and unsaturated lipids during evaporation.

carrierGases.name: Sanitary HEPA Desiccant Dehumidified Air (Dewpoint -40°C)
carrierGases.oxidationRisk: Low (Low moisture mobility suppresses free radicals)
carrierGases.description: Cost-effective food-grade air passing through dual-tower silica/molecular sieve desiccant beds and 0.2-micron sterile filters for standard food ingredients.

carrierGases.name: Cryo-Cooled Dry Nitrogen Stream (12°C, Dewpoint -60°C)
carrierGases.description: Sub-ambient nitrogen flow designed for ultra-sensitive enzymes and probiotics with strict thermal denaturation points below 25°C.

acousticContainmentEnclosures.name: Tri-Layer Heavy Viscoelastic Acoustic Barrier (Lead-Loaded Vinyl + Mineral Rockwool Core + AISI 304 Outer Shell)
acousticContainmentEnclosures.description: Industrial heavy-gauge acoustic enclosure absorbing ultrasonic emission and sub-harmonic acoustic noise, providing safe factory floor operation.

acousticContainmentEnclosures.name: Sanitary Dual-Pane Acoustic Polycarbonate Inspection Enclosure (12 mm laminated + argon gap)
acousticContainmentEnclosures.description: Optically clear cleanroom enclosure allowing real-time high-speed video tracking of levitated droplet aspect ratio and drying shrinkage.

acousticContainmentEnclosures.name: Acoustic Labyrinth Vented Airflow Exhaust Silencer (Baffled Sound Absorber)
acousticContainmentEnclosures.description: Multi-stage baffle silencer integrated into carrier gas exhaust ducts, preventing ultrasonic acoustic leakage through air inlet/outlet ports.
